subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Oil Age
description: Learn The Oil Age in one minute.

hook.text: From 1920 to 1990, electric cars were essentially gone. Gasoline ruled without challenge.

buildup.text: Cheap oil, expanding highways, and powerful engines made gas cars faster and more convenient every decade.

discovery.text: Car culture became oil culture. Gas stations, road trips, and drive-throughs defined American life.

twist.text: The 1973 oil embargo caused gas shortages and mile-long lines. But memory faded once prices dropped.

climax.text: For 70 years, almost nobody in the auto industry seriously worked on electric vehicles.

punchline.text: The world forgot that cars were once electric.

quiz.question: How long were electric cars essentially absent from the market?
